meaning:
περι-φέρω
[in LXX: Ecc.7:8 (7) (הָלַל po.), al. ;]
to carry about: Mrk.6:55, 2Co.4:10. Pass., metaphorically: Eph.4:14.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick, on their mats, to where they heard he was.
always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.
that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles…
